description: Defines the StatusCommand structure implementing a command-line interface command to show daemon status, including configuration loading and recent transcript display.

classes.name: StatusCommand
classes.description: A command structure conforming to ParsableCommand that displays daemon status info including wake configuration and recent transcripts.

methods.name: init(parsed: ParsedValues)
methods.description: Initializer that parses command options from ParsedValues.

methods.name: run()
methods.description: Asynchronous method executing the command's main logic to display status info.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Computed property converting configPath string to URL.
